column3: POST /v1/cmd accepts an array of up to 32 frames run in order; the web client batches commands issued in one task and caches pure reads by op+args, cleared by any successful command and by a home snap
column4: Opening Extensions -> Customize fired 5 ops = 5 Worker + 5 home requests + receipts; screens overlapped and refetched the same lists
column5: src/cmd.test.ts: 5 reads in one batch cost 1 home request vs 5 sent alone; web/src/lib/cmd.test.ts: Customize opens with 1 request, reopening costs 0, a mutation or home snap forces one refetch
